name: alma-herdr-android
description: Independent multi-host Herdr client in the nanami Android shell

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build:web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:ui: tsx client-tests/browser-smoke.ts && tsx client-tests/scan-flow-check.ts && tsx client-tests/prompt-ui-check.ts && tsx client-tests/markdown-ui-check.ts && tsx client-tests/session-name-ui-check.ts && tsx client-tests/transcript-gap-ui-check.ts
